title: file-type-contract _rationale content-class bounds
description: Governs a single governance/file-type-contracts/*.json object. Bounds every *_rationale field (the reader-facing WHY that is kept inline) so build-archaeology cannot re-accumulate or hide in it. Consumed by the release gate contract-shape check and by the /govern file-type registration path when validating a newly registered type contract. The archaeology vocabulary here is deliberately the generic, shape-class set: personal or confidential literals are owned by the full-surface PII scan, and release-cleaner-strippable literals can never survive into a shipped rationale, so neither class belongs in this pattern. Only *_rationale keys are constrained; all other keys are unconstrained (additionalProperties: true).
